  • Each interface had 12 attempts: API passed 12, accessibility 10, Page JSON 9, and pixels 4.
  • On 10 shared passes, API used a median 6.3 fewer seconds and 3 fewer actions than accessibility.
  • API skips browser interaction, so its higher completion count does not show better computer use.
  • Verified: 35 passed · 1 incomplete · 12 blocked. $8.2343 usage + $0.7334 unresolved = $8.9677 of $25. Six requests lack receipts.
  • Two repeats each of thread reply, message editing and incident closeout. The earlier 96 attempts remain a separate study.
  • All-attempt times include stops. Shared-pass timing selects on success. Low-detail pixels, macOS keys and two repeats limit what this comparison establishes.
